title: Execution Ledger
description: The Structured Extraction Schema the execution-auditor agent must populate. Strict: no extra keys anywhere.

executive_summary.description: A concise, objective 1-2 sentence summary of what was actually achieved during the execution session.

completed_actions.description: Tasks that were successfully finished and validated.

task.description: The specific action taken (e.g., 'Generated React component', 'Queried PostgreSQL database').

artifact_proof.description: The explicit evidence of completion from the log (e.g., 'File saved to /src/components/Button.tsx', 'API returned 201 Created').

out_of_scope_items.description: Requests made by the user that were not fulfilled due to constraints, irrelevance, or missing tools.

requested_feature.description: What the user asked for that was not done.

rejection_reason.description: Why it was not done (e.g., 'Requires write permissions to production DB', 'No email tool available').

pending_follow_ups.description: Tasks that failed during execution or require human intervention/subsequent agent runs.

blocker.description: What is preventing completion right now (e.g., 'Missing API key', 'Rate limit exceeded on GitHub API').
